title: AI assistance
note: GATED: recorded only in one owner-approved live session on a stack started with fix-stack --ai, SHOWCASE_AI=1. Budget: 12 AI requests, counted by the spec, never retried automatically. Lower-thirds follow docs/PRICING.md section 2.6 (ai_assistant and ai_message_compose on every plan; extraction, scoring, scan and search on Pro and Enterprise; ai_intelligence on Pro and Enterprise).

scenes.title: AI that drafts, you decide
scenes.subtitle: Every AI action asks first and is metered in credits
scenes.narration: The AI in TravelCRM Pro drafts and summarises. Nothing is sent or charged to a customer without you, and every request is counted in credits.
With AI switched on, the model reads each incoming message: it labels it, and when there is work, it understands the trip. The suggestion is marked as AI.
Paste an enquiry from anywhere, and the AI turns it into a contact and a lead for you to check.
The composer drafts a message in your tone. You edit it before anything goes out.
Describe a trip, and the itinerary generator proposes a day-by-day plan to start from.
Marketing can draft a social media post for an offer in seconds.
Ask your data a question in plain English, like which Goa leads are travelling in December.
Lead scores rank who is most likely to book, and smart follow-ups suggest who to call next.
Insights, a business briefing and a health score read your numbers and point out what changed.

scenes.heading: And more, on the same credits
scenes.narration: There is more on the same credits, not shown running here: scanning passports and supplier bills, summaries of recorded calls that turn into suggested next steps, destination profitability, team workload and customer segments.

scenes.headline: AI that drafts. People who decide.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. AI that drafts, and people who decide.
